blocked.name: Jester's Scepter
blocked.why: The putFromExile cost records nothing about the card it moved, so 'the same name as that card' has nothing to read; sameNameWith 'exiled-with-source' matches any linked card.

blocked.name: Leori, Sparktouched Hunter
blocked.why: choose-value has no planeswalker-type choice, and every activation of that type this turn is copied, not just the next.

blocked.name: Cmdr. Troi, Outgoing Empath
blocked.why: copy-all of { thisWay: 'cast' } copies only spells the effect's controller controls; the opponent cast this one.

blocked.name: Urza Assembles the Titans
blocked.why: loyalty-activations covers one permanent; chapter III covers every planeswalker you control this turn, later arrivals included.

blocked.name: Verdant Mastery
blocked.why: One find goes onto the battlefield under an opponent's control; search-library's split is two-way and `under` takes only you.

blocked.name: Twists and Turns // Mycoid Maze
blocked.why: Game.exploreTimes reads only modify.times, so the replacement's scry 1 first would never run.

blocked.name: Warrior's Blades
blocked.why: targetCostReduction reads a number, the target's colors or its power, not its +1/+1 counters.

blocked.name: Invasion Plans
blocked.why: choose-combat is a one-shot effect; no static form for every combat.

blocked.name: Signal the Clans
blocked.why: Nothing picks one at random among a search's finds, gated on three distinct names, with the rest shuffled back.

blocked.name: Urgent Necropsy
blocked.why: kicker.collectEvidence is a fixed optional number; the card's is a mandatory cost of the targets' total mana value.

blocked.name: Judgment of Alexander
blocked.why: 'Whenever damage from a creature is prevented this way' is a trigger tied to this effect; damage-rule's `then` happens at once and the prevented event can't be narrowed to one effect.

blocked.name: Shared Fate
blocked.why: Each player may play only the cards they exiled with it; StaticPlay grants the controller alone.

blocked.name: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom
blocked.why: The front's cast one, hand one, the other staying exiled if none is cast (the ruling); both faces wait.

blocked.name: Capricious Hellraiser
blocked.why: Three cards at random as one event: three choose-random-card moves would fire a 'one or more cards leave your graveyard' trigger three times (rule 603.2c). Authored by the agent, dropped in review.
